note: Conceptual/architecture lesson on availability as a distinct NFR and RTO/RPO-driven disaster recovery design. No screenshots per this course's conceptual/architecture policy. This lesson deliberately avoids stating a specific platform-wide Salesforce uptime percentage or a specific native RTO/RPO number (e.g., a precise hours figure), because WebSearch during this session found conflicting third-party claims (varying between different blog/vendor sources) with no single authoritative Salesforce-published figure confirming either, and trust.salesforce.com itself was confirmed to be a status/transparency site rather than a page stating one guaranteed uptime percentage or RTO/RPO number for the core platform. Per the build brief's instruction, the lesson describes the concepts and the need to verify current contractual SLA terms per-product rather than inventing a precise figure.
